主要内容: Credicorp Ltd. (the ‘Company’) announced changes to its corporate governance structure, effective from April 2020. The Board of Directors decided to reduce the number of Board Committees from 7 to 4, dissolving the Executive Committee and the Investment Committee. The Audit Committee, Corporate Governance Committee, and Risks Committee will remain, while the Compensation Committee will merge with the Nominations Committee under the new name of Compensation and Nominations Committee. The Chairman of the Board will only participate in the Risk Committee and the Compensation and Nominations Committee, without presiding over these committees. The Company also plans to amend Bye-Law 4.11 to increase the number of Directors from 8 to 9. The Annual General Meeting of Shareholders is scheduled for March 27, 2020, with a potential postponement to April 3, 2020, if the required quorum is not met. Shareholders registered by February 18, 2020, will be entitled to attend and vote. The meeting will address the Annual Report for the financial year ended December 31, 2019, audited consolidated financial statements, director elections, and partial amendments to the Bye-Laws, including Bye-Law 4.11, and the appointment of external auditors for the 2020 financial year.
